Dark: Unless you control an adjacent site, We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! is canceled.” Playtest image: uploaded on 22 June 2021, the evening before the set's official release (23 June 2021), and replaced on release day. The card is stored upright (portrait: PNG 703×980; GIF 745×1039, holotable 7df3091); the same day the files were renamed (holotable 30816d1, “filename fixes”, same image). Words as on the released card.
* '''Original''' (this page): Card image published 23 June 2021<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstartrashcompactor.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstartrashcompactor.gif holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstartrashcompactor.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstartrashcompactor.png holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: During your move phase, you may move to here for free from any Death Star site. Dark: Unless you control an adjacent site, We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! is canceled.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 15 release (23 June 2021): the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown (holotable 9319460, “fixing rotation on v15”: PNG 980×703, GIF 745×534). Same image, words and layout as the playtest upload apart from the orientation. Every published image that differs from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Trash Compactor (V) (Errata)]]): Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstartrashcompactor.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstartrashcompactor.gif holotable commit 3f7288d], 21 April 2022); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstartrashcompactor.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstartrashcompactor.png holotable commit 2640d50], 20 April 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: During your move phase, you may move to here for free from any Death Star site. Dark: Unless you control an adjacent site, We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! is canceled.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card from a new high-resolution master (holotable 2640d50, “Set 18 and errata”, 20 April 2022: PNG now 1039×745; the GIF copy, holotable 3f7288d, 21 April 2022, stays 745×534), so art, frame, icons and text all render slightly differently. Most visibly: the art is re-coloured (lighter, less saturated green) and the icons and lightsaber bars are redrawn; the Decipher copyright line down the right border stays. Words unchanged.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star: Trash Compactor (V) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstartrashcompactor.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstartrashcompactor.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: During your move phase, you may move to here for free from any Death Star site. Dark: Unless you control an adjacent site, We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! is canceled.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF copy (the file the PC card data uses) at a larger size, 745×534 → 1039×745 pixels, with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, 11 June 2022, which re-made the landscape GIFs of Virtual Sets 4 and 14–18 and 11 alternate-image cards; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name). It is the same card enlarged — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged; the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG copy the PC had published on 20 April 2022 (<code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstartrashcompactor.png</code>), which until then appeared only in the <code>hires</code> folder. A visible (resolution) change of the card image, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
